item3_file_clock_only.why: `Nf_*` is built from the FILE clocks of the other aircraft in the cell, so it is defined on every row of every airport whether the harvest heard it or not. It is the only neighbourhood family LTFM can have: round 4 verified `No_n_res_cell` finite on none of LTFM's 25,185 no-clock 2026-07 rows and `Nf_n_res_cell` finite on 24,794 of them.

note:
The desk's 2026-09-09 fold-side questions.  Nothing is served and nothing is fitted
to a board reading; every number here is the fold side of the no-clock class.

projection_weights.note: per airport-MONTH (desk 17:05 UTC) and per REACH CLASS (FALLBACK round 3, blocking 1): the ranking block gives the rows, the class and the reached share, so an airport dark in one month (LIRF in 2026-07, LTFM in both) carries all of that month's rows in the no-clock class, none in the with-clock class, and almost all of them in the UNREACHED half, which is priced on the fold's own unreached rows.
